items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: "What was the name of that show, Lord? The Lady Lee. Lady Lee, eh? Oh, yes. Yeah, it says Lady Lee. Lady Lee."

ctx.x: He sort of looks, yeah, looks a little heavy here, you know. He is a little heavy.

Well, I'll tell you what makes I look similar. Of course, I wasn't much more heavier. But I'll tell you, them big old pants, what they got on here. Yeah. Yeah, yeah. They're nice. They're pretty costumes, you know. Yeah. And nothing but like a plantation person, you know. With them big old hats when you're working in the field or something. Well, that's what they did. We had light straw hats and them pretty striped things. Overhauls. Yeah, overhauls. As it imitate when you're working in a cotton. Nothing but a…
Chicago girl now. See? See that? Is there anything about Roy Palmer that you can tell us?
